groups.algorithm: Per-row rotary transform for independent query and key outputs; half-split or interleaved partners, shared cos/sin inputs.
alternatives: Keep per-row ownership and replace scalar half-rotation arithmetic with exact-order vector Mul/Add operations.
Batch heads for cos/sin reuse changes row task shape; reconsider after profiling traffic and scalar-cost evidence.
groups.ownership: Disjoint output ownership; no cross-core writes to another task output.
groups.synchronization: Per-core input/compute/output dependencies; no cross-core synchronization.
groups.task_partition: Each core owns complete contiguous rows, reads broadcast trig values, and writes both outputs exactly once.
groups.workspace_formula: 0 global intermediate; any new cross-core reduction or carry pass requires revised plan.
